svg.title: Automation and deployment — protected state, reviewed publication
svg.desc: Scheduled or manual workflows serialize canonical operations through a shared writer lock. The reusable processor restores verified state, checks the reviewed-state seal, migrates, executes the selected CLI phases, validates projections, and publishes round-trip-verified restricted snapshots. A separate job receives only the README and creates a validated review pull request. Deployment is a separate approved run after the matching README is merged, not an automatic consequence of merging.
